blocks.text: FT：Anthropic 的银行家计划在投资者需求旺盛后上调其 IPO 价格，将目标估值重新提升至 1.5 万亿美元或更高。

inlines.text: FT：Anthropic 的银行家计划在投资者需求旺盛后上调其 IPO 价格，将目标估值重新提升至 1.5 万亿美元或更高。

blocks.text: 周二的申报文件设定了每股 70 至 78 美元的价格区间，计入员工期权和限制性股票后，隐含估值为 1.26 万亿至 1.41 万亿美元。

inlines.text: 周二的申报文件设定了每股 70 至 78 美元的价格区间，计入员工期权和限制性股票后，隐含估值为 1.26 万亿至 1.41 万亿美元。

blocks.text: 若定价高于该区间，募资额将超过 1000 亿美元，其中包括 Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 将按 IPO 价格投资的 260 亿美元。

inlines.text: 若定价高于该区间，募资额将超过 1000 亿美元，其中包括 Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 将按 IPO 价格投资的 260 亿美元。

blocks.text: 三位支持者表示，Anthropic 现在更看重筹集现金，而非最大化估值，因为它计划投入约 9000 亿美元用于算力和基础设施支出。

blocks.text: FT: Anthropic’s bankers plan to raise its IPO price after heavy investor demand, lifting the target valuation back to $1.5T or more.

inlines.text: FT: Anthropic’s bankers plan to raise its IPO price after heavy investor demand, lifting the target valuation back to $1.5T or more.

blocks.text: Tuesday’s filing set a $70-$78 share range, implying $1.26T to $1.41T once employee options and restricted shares are counted.

inlines.text: Tuesday’s filing set a $70-$78 share range, implying $1.26T to $1.41T once employee options and restricted shares are counted.

blocks.text: Pricing above that range would push proceeds past $100B, including $26B that Google, Nvidia and Microsoft will invest at the IPO price.

blocks.text: Three backers say Anthropic now cares more about raising cash than maximizing valuation, because it plans about $900B of compute and infrastructure spending.
